text:
I wrote the review report with verdict `fix` and made no code edits. I did not read the whole diff. I read the brief, the diff's `Form.css` and `readme.md`, the `layout.json`, and the 1200 px and sheet screenshots. I never opened the 400, 1920 and 3440 px images.

The three `[fix]` findings:
- **Cards never seen:** the screenshots show only the top of the page, which is 8597 px tall at 400 px. The 20 type cards and their desktop grid are in no shot, so the owner's core ask is unchecked.
- **No landing line:** the task log has no "stage 1 landed" entry. The agent was closed by the harness partway through checking why the cards sat in a narrow column, so a fresh agent can't tell if that was fixed.
- **Readme gap:** `ux/Form/readme.md` leaves `doc/` out of its on-disk listing, though the diff adds `doc/file/*.md` and `doc/files.jsonl`.

The four `[note]` items:
- Two literal `#1a1a1a` colour values in `Form.css`, against the brief's "no new colour values".
- The `h2` headings wrap to two lines at 400 px.
- Stage 2 (stepper, quiz, JSON panel) isn't in the diff, which the brief allows.
- The readme says a stepper layout "will reuse" `ux/Wizard`, which is a plan rather than a fact.

I didn't run `node Server/smoke.mjs` or the tests. The report records smoke as not evidenced.

The report is `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/25/spawned/mastermind-forms/kit/review/report.md`.

I wrote the report with verdict `pass`. It has four findings, all notes and no fixes, and I made no code edits.

- **Shots:** the 1200, 1920 and 3440 shots show only the top of the page. No shot shows the stepper or quiz layouts, or the card grid at desktop widths, so I couldn't judge those.
- **Empty space:** it rises with width, from 0.34 at 400 to 0.74 at 3440, because the text column stays narrow.
- **Wrapping:** the first h2 wraps to two lines at 400 and takes up some of the first screen.
- **Docs:** I found nothing unindexed or stale. `ux/readme.md` has the Form line, `Form/readme.md` lists every file, and the task log records both stages with their commits, so a fresh agent could continue from it. The work is not merged yet.

The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/25/spawned/mastermind-forms/kit/review/report.md`.
